notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS evaluating hosted API first, then moving to Dedicated if economics align. Primary workloads: candidate ranking/reranking for recommendations, embeddings for similarity search, and an in-app chat assistant for customers.

Performance and cost targets: p95 chat latency <250ms for user-facing flows; embedding pipeline throughput target ~150-250 qps (batchable); cost sensitivity: want to keep token cost + infra below $0.10/user/month for pilot scale.

Model preferences: open/LLM family: prefer quantizable Mistral/LLama-derivatives or optimized 13B/7B variants; willing to use quantized int8/int4 if accuracy loss <2-3% on eval prompts. Need fallbacks for peak traffic.

Security/Compliance: SSO (SAML) mandatory for admin console; data residency requirement EU for EU customers; audit logging + KMS integration needed for production.

POC scope: 3-week bench + 4-week pilot using hosted API. If latency and unit economics meet targets, evaluate Dedicated with 6–12 month reserved capacity (burst to hosted).

Cost-optimization workshop agenda (requested):
- Measurement: current POC telemetry & token distribution analysis
- Batching: recommended batch sizes by request type and impact on p95 latency
- Caching: prefix/KV cache strategy for chat sessions and repeated queries
- Quantization: candidate quantization profiles (int8, int4) and expected perf/cost tradeoffs
- Unit economics: per-feature cost breakdown, suggestion of price buckets for Dedicated commits
- Next actions: PoC benchmark checklist, dedicated sizing worksheet, list of eval prompts for regen testing

Sales notes / quotes: 'If we can shave 25% off token spend without hurting LTV signals, we can justify a reserved commit.' — Head of Product.

Open items: vendor SD sheet pending (security team request), exact commit discount thresholds to hit ARR band, final acceptance criteria for accuracy regression.
